title: Stripe Live secret key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: sk_live_ written with hyphens (sk-live-) (basis: provider). Twin of "Stripe Live restricted key, Stripe Live secret key and 1 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of stripe-token-httpie-bearer: prefix: sk_live_ written with hyphens (sk-live-) (basis: provider). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
